title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.48: Practice is no longer Stable, so like any other Tuned card it becomes Unplayable once played instead of being replayable all combat - and other cards can now make it Tuned, Planned or ordered. To compensate it applies Tuned to 2 cards instead of 1 (3 upgraded).
